arabic_text: يَا رَبِّ يَا رَبِّ يَا رَبِّ
transliteration: yā rabbi yā rabbi yā rabbi
english_text: My Lord! My Lord! My Lord!

arabic_text: يَا إِلَهِي وَسَيِّدِي وَمَوْلايَ وَمَاِلكَ رِقِّي
transliteration: yā ilāhī wa-sayyidī wa-mawlāy wa-mālik raqqī
english_text: My God! My Master! My Protector! Owner of my bondage!

arabic_text: يَا مَنْ بِيَدِهِ نَاصِيَتِي
transliteration: yā man bi-yadihi nāṣīyatī
english_text: O He in whose hand is my forelock!

arabic_text: يَا عَلِيمًا بِضُرِّي وَمَسْكَنَتِي
transliteration: yā ʿalīman biḍurrī wa maskanatī
english_text: O He who knows my affliction and my misery!

arabic_text: يَا خَبِيرًا بِفَقْرِي وَفَاقَتِي
transliteration: yā khabīran bifaqri wa faqatī
english_text: O He who is aware of my poverty and indigence!

arabic_text: يَا رَبِّ يَا رَبِّ يَا رَبِّ
transliteration: yā rabbi, yā rabbi, yā rabbi
english_text: My Lord! My Lord! My Lord!

arabic_text: أَسْأَلُكَ بِحَقِّكَ وَقُدْسِكَ وَأَعْظَمِ صِفَاتِكَ وَأَسْمَائِكَ أنْ تَجْعَلَ أَوْقَاتِي فِى اللَّيلِ وَالنَّهَارِ بِذِكْرِكَ مَعْمُورَةً، وَبِخِدْمَتِكَ مَوْصُولَةً،
transliteration: as'aluka bihaqqika wa qudsika wa'aʿẓami ṣifātika wa'asmā'ika 'an taj'al awqatī fil-layli wan-nahāri bidhikrika ma'mūrah wa bi-khidmatika mawṣūlatan
english_text: I ask You by Your Truth and Your Holiness And the greatest of Your Attributes and Names, That You make my times in the night and the day inhabited by Your remembrance, And joined to Your service

arabic_text: وَّأَعْمَاِلي عِنْدَكَ مَقْبُولَةً، حَتَّى تَكُونَ أَعْمَاِلي وَأَوْرَادِي كُلُّهَا وِرْدًا وَّاحِدًا، وَّحَاِلي فِي خِدْمَتِكَ سَرْمَدًا
transliteration: wa aʿmālī ʿindaka maqbūlatan ḥattá takūna aʿmālī waʾawrādī kulluhā wirḍan wāḥidan waḥāli fī khidmatika sarmadan
english_text: And my works acceptable to You, So that my works and my litanies may all be a single litany And my occupation with Your service everlasting.

arabic_text: يَا سَيِّدِي، يَا مَنْ عَلَيْهِ مُعَوَّلِي
transliteration: yā sayyidī, yā man ʿalayhi muʿawwaliyy
english_text: My Master! O He upon whom I depend!

arabic_text: يَا مَنْ إلَيْهِ شَكَوْتُ أَحْوَاِلي
transliteration: yā man ilayhi shakawtu aḥwālī
english_text: O He to whom I complain about my states!

arabic_text: يَا رَبِّ يَا رَبِّ يَا رَبِّ
transliteration: yā rabbi yā rabbi yā rabbi
english_text: My Lord! My Lord! My Lord!

arabic_text: قَوِّ عَلَى خِدْمَتِكَ جَوَارِحِي وَاشْدُدْ عَلىَ الْعَزِيمَةِ جَوَانِحِي وَهَبْ لِيَ الْجِدَّ فِي خَشْيَتِكَ وَالدَّوَامَ فِي الإِتِّصَاِل بِخِدْمَتِكَ
transliteration: qawwī ʿalá khidmatika jawārīḥī wa-ashuddu ʿalal-ʿazeemati jawanihi. wa hab liyal-jidda fee khashyatika wa al-dawāma fil i'ttiṣāl bi-khidmatika
english_text: Strengthen my bodily members in Your service, And fortify my ribs in determination And bestow upon me earnestness in my fear of You And continuity in my being joined to Your service

arabic_text: حَتَّى أَسْرَحَ إِلَيكَ فِي مَيَادِينِ السَّابِقِينَ وَأُسْرِعَ إلَيْكَ فِي الْمبُادِرِينَ وَأَشْتَاقَ إلىَ قُرْبِكَ فِي الْمُشْتَاقِينَ وَأَدْنُوَ مِنْكَ دُنُوَّ الْمُخْلِصِينَ
transliteration: ḥattá ʾasraḥa ʾilayka fī mayādīni al-sābiqīn wa usri'a ilayka fil mubadirin wa-ash-taqā ilā qur-bika fī al-mushtāqīn wa adnū min ka dunūwal-mukhliṣīn
english_text: So that I may move easily toward You in the battlefields of the foremost And hurry to You among the prominent And desire fervently Your proximity among the fervently desirous And move nearer to You with the nearness of the sincere

arabic_text: وَأَخَافَكَ مَخَافَةَ الْمُوقِنِينَ وَأَجْتَمِعَ فِي جِوَارِكَ مَعَ الْمُؤْمنِينَ
transliteration: wa-akhāfak(a) makhāfat(a) al-muqinīn wa-ʾajtamiʿa fī jiwarika maʿa al-muʾminīn
english_text: And fear You with the fear of those who have certitude And gather with the believers in Your vicinity.

arabic_text: اَللَّهُمَّ وَمَنْ أَرَادَنِي بِسُوٍء فَأَرِدْهُ
transliteration: allāhumma wa man arādani bi-sū’in fa-aridhu
english_text: O Allah, whoever desires evil for me, desire [it] for him!

arabic_text: وَمَنْ كَادَنِي فَكِدْهُ
transliteration: wa man kādana fakidhuhu
english_text: whoever deceives me-deceive him!

arabic_text: وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنْ أَحْسَنِ عَبِيدِكَ نَصِيبًا عِنْدَكَ وَأَقْرَبِهِم مَّنْزِلَةً مِّنْكَ وَأَخَصِّهِمْ زُلْفَةً لَّدَيْكَ
transliteration: wa-jʿalnī min aḥsani ʿibādika naṣīban ʿindaka wa-aqrabihim manzilatan minka wa-akhassihim zulfatan ladayka
english_text: And make me one of the most excellent of Your slaves in Portion from You, And the nearest of them in station to You And the most elect of them in proximity to You.

arabic_text: فَإِنَّهُ لا يُنَالُ ذَلِكَ إِلاّ بِفَضْلِكَ
transliteration: fa'innahu la yunālu dhālika illā bifadlika
english_text: For that cannot be attained except by Your bounty.

arabic_text: وَجُدْ لِي بِجُودِكَ وَاعْطِفْ عَلَيَّ بِمَجْدِكَ وَاحْفَظْنِي بِرَحْمَتِكَ
transliteration: wa judli bi joodika wa ʿaṭif ʿalayya bimajdika wa aḥfaẓnī bir-raḥmatika
english_text: And grant generously to me through Your munificence, And incline toward me with Your splendour And protect me with Your mercy!

arabic_text: وَاجْعَل لِّسَانِي بِذِكْرِكَ لَهِجًا وَقَلْبِي بِحُبِّكَ مُتَيَّمًا
transliteration: wa-jʿal lisanī bi-dhikrika lahiǧan wa qalbi biḥubbi-ka mutayyaman
english_text: And make my tongue remember You without ceasing And my heart enthralled by Your love!

arabic_text: وَّمُنَّ عَلَيَّ بِحُسْنِ إِجَابَتِكَ وَأَقِلْنِي عَثْرَتِي وَاغْفِرْ زَلَّتِي
transliteration: wamunna ʿalayya biḥusni ijābatika wa aqilni ʿathrati wa-aghfir zallati
english_text: And be gracious to me by answering me favourably, And nullify my slips And forgive my lapses!

arabic_text: فَإِنَّكَ قَضَيْتَ عَلَى عِبَادِكَ بِعِبَادَتِكَ وَأَمَرْتَهُم بِدُعَائِكَ وَضَمِنْتَ لَهُمُ الإِجَابَةَ
transliteration: fa'innaka qadaīta ʿalā ʿibādika biʿibādatika wa amartahum biduʿaika waḍaminta lahumul ijābah
english_text: For Thou hast decreed Your worship for Your servants And commanded them to supplicate You And assured them that they would be answered.

arabic_text: فَإِلَيْكَ يَا رَبِّ نَصَبْتُ وَجْهِي وَإلَيْكَ يَا رَبِّ مَدَدْتُ يَدِي
transliteration: fa'ilayka ya rabb insabtu wajhi wa-ilayka ya rabbi madadtu yadi
english_text: So toward You, my Lord, I have turned my face And toward You, my Lord, I have extended my hand.

arabic_text: فَبِعِزَّتِكَ اسْتَجِبْ لِي دُعَائِي وَبَلِّغْنِي مُنَايَ
transliteration: fa biʿizzatika astajib li duʿāʾi wa ballighnī munāya
english_text: So by Your might, comply with my supplication And make me attain my desires!

arabic_text: وَلا تَقْطَعْ مِن فَضْلِكَ رَجَائِي وَاكْفِنِي شَرَّ الْجِنِّ وَالإِنْسِ مِنْ أَعْدَائِي
transliteration: walā taqṭaʿ min faḍlika rajāʾī wakfinī sharra al-jinni wal-insi min aʿdā'ī
english_text: Do not severe my hopes of Your favours And spare me the evil of my enemies from among the jinn and men!

arabic_text: يَا سَرِيعَ الرِّضَا
transliteration: yā sarīʿa al-riḍā
english_text: O He, whose pleasure is quickly achieved!

arabic_text: اِغْفِرْ لِمَن لا يَمْلِكُ إِلا الدُّعَاءَ فَإِنَّكَ فَعَّالٌ لِّمَا تَشَاءُ
transliteration: ighfir liman la yamliku illa addu'aa' fa'innaka fa'ālun limā tashā'u
english_text: Forgive him who owns nothing but supplication For You do what You will.

arabic_text: يَا مَنْ اسْمُهُ دَوَاءٌ وَذِكْرُهُ شِفَاءٌ وَطَاعَتُهُ غِنًى
transliteration: yā man asmuhu dawā'un wa dhikruhu shifa'un waṭāʿatuhu ghinā
english_text: O He whose Name is a remedy, And whose remembrance is a cure, And whose obedience is wealth!

arabic_text: ارْحَم مَّن رَّأْسُ مَاِلهِ الرَّجَاءُ وَسِلاَحُهُ الْبُكَاءُ
transliteration: arḥam man raʾsu māʾilih al-rajaʾ wasilāhu al-bukāʾu
english_text: Have mercy upon him whose capital is hope And whose weapon is tears!

arabic_text: يَا سَاِبغَ النِّعَمِ
transliteration: yā sāibgha al-niʿam
english_text: O Ample in blessings!
